description: The canonical output of compiling an Oval document: the data model with every reference resolved, plus derived fields for renderers. Keys mirror the language's keywords.
title: Oval compiled guide

oval.description: The major version of the Oval language the document declares in its version marker.

parties.description: Every party declared at the top level or inline, in document order.

candidates.description: Every candidate declared at the top level or inline, in document order.

questions.description: Derived. Every contest and measure in ballot order, with where it sits in the tree.

counts.description: Derived. Totals across the whole document.

identifier.description: An entity identifier without its leading @.

markdown.description: A Markdown body with its common indentation removed, line terminators normalized to \n, and no trailing terminator.

guide.description: The document-level fields: what the guide is and which election it covers.

election.description: The election as named on the ballot, from `election`.

name.description: The party's name as printed on the ballot.

abbreviation.description: The short form printed beside candidates, from `abbreviation`.

note.description: The author's note on the party, from `note`.

candidates.description: Derived. Identifiers of every candidate whose party this is, in document order.

candidate.description: A person who appears in one or more campaigns.

name.description: The candidate's name as printed on the ballot.

designation.description: The occupation or title printed beside the name, from `designation`.

party.description: Identifier of the candidate's party, from `party`.

note.description: The author's note on the candidate, from `note`.

contests.description: Derived. Identifiers of every contest in which the candidate is a campaign member, in ballot order.

ballot.description: A ballot: a root ballot or a sub-ballot for a narrower electorate.

title.description: The jurisdiction or grouping the ballot covers.

note.description: The author's note on the ballot, from `note`.

path.description: Derived. Identifiers of the enclosing ballots, outermost first, not including this one. Empty for a root.

items.description: Sections, contests, measures, and sub-ballots in ballot order.

ballot_item.description: One entry of a ballot: a section, contest, measure, or sub-ballot.

section.description: A titled group of contests and measures within a ballot.

title.description: The section's title as printed on the ballot.

note.description: The author's note on the section, from `note`.

items.description: Contests and measures in ballot order.

location.description: Derived. Where a question sits in the ballot tree.

ballot.description: Identifier of the innermost enclosing ballot.

section.description: Title of the enclosing section, when there is one.

path.description: Identifiers of every enclosing ballot, outermost first, ending with `ballot`.

method.description: The voting method, from the contest header.

seats.description: How many candidates are elected, from `multiple`.

max.description: How many candidates a voter may rank, from `max`, when the contest limits it.

contest.description: A race between campaigns for an office.

title.description: The contest as named on the ballot.

subtitle.description: A line printed under the title, from `subtitle`.

method.description: The voting method, from the contest header.

note.description: The author's note on the contest, from `note`.

location.description: Derived. Where the contest sits in the ballot tree.

campaigns.description: In ballot order. A campaign is referred to by its index in this array.

recommendation.description: The author's recommendation on the contest.

campaign.description: One or more candidates running together for a contest.

index.description: Derived. Position in the contest's campaigns array.

label.description: Derived. The members' names joined with " / ", head of ticket first.

head.description: Derived. Identifier of the first member: the head of the ticket, and the name the recommendation uses for this campaign.

party.description: Derived. The party shared by every member, when all members have the same one.

members.description: The campaign's candidates, head of ticket first.

incumbent.description: Whether the campaign currently occupies the office, from the `incumbent` flag.

withdrawn.description: Whether the campaign has ended but remains on the ballot, from the `withdrawn` flag.

note.description: The author's note on the campaign, from `note`.

stance.description: Derived. What the contest's recommendation says about this campaign.

member.description: A candidate's place on a campaign.

role.description: The member's role on the ticket, from `as`.

note.description: The author's note on this member, from the member's `note`.

stance.description: Derived. What the contest's recommendation says about this campaign.

tier.description: Zero-based index of the support tier the campaign appears in.

contest_recommendation.description: The author's recommendation on a contest.

no_position.description: Whether the author takes no position, from `recommend no-position`.

support.description: Tiers as written: candidate identifiers, most preferred tier first. Empty when no_position.

oppose.description: Candidate identifiers as written. Empty when no_position.

support_campaigns.description: Derived. The same tiers resolved to campaign indices.

oppose_campaigns.description: Derived. The opposed campaigns as indices.

note.description: The author's note on the recommendation, from `note`.

measure.description: A ballot measure: a question answered yes or no.

description.description: The question as printed on the ballot, from `description`.

title.description: The measure as named on the ballot.

subtitle.description: A line printed under the title, from `subtitle`.

if_yes.description: What a yes vote does, from `if_yes`.

if_no.description: What a no vote does, from `if_no`.

placement.description: How the measure reached the ballot, from `placement`.

tabulation.description: What it takes to pass, from `tabulation`.

supporters.description: Organizations supporting the measure, from `supporters`. Omitted when not researched; empty when researched and none known.

opponents.description: Organizations opposing the measure, from `opponents`. Omitted when not researched; empty when researched and none known.

note.description: The author's note on the measure, from `note`.

location.description: Derived. Where the measure sits in the ballot tree.

recommendation.description: The author's recommendation on the measure.

measure_recommendation.description: The author's recommendation on a measure.

note.description: The author's note on the recommendation, from `note`.

question_entry.description: Derived. One contest or measure in the document's flat index of questions.

kind.description: Whether the question is a `contest` or a `measure`.

location.description: Where the question sits in the ballot tree.

counts.description: Derived. Totals across the whole document.

ballots.description: Every ballot, roots and sub-ballots alike.
